prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Tyler TX?
answer_verbatim:
I don’t have live web access right now, so I can’t look up the latest local ratings — would you like me to search for current options? If so, tell me your ZIP or the part of Tyler you’re near and whether you want UV tanning (beds/stand‑ups) or spray tanning.

If you’d rather decide now, here’s the fastest way to pick the best salon and what to look for:

How to find the best salon
- Search Google Maps and Yelp for “tanning salon Tyler TX” and sort by rating + recent reviews (look for reviews in the last 3 months).
- Check Facebook pages for photos, customer comments, and announcements about equipment or safety updates.
- Look on Groupon or local deal sites if price is important — they often list trusted local shops.
- Call the salon and ask questions (see below).

What to ask/inspect (quality checklist)
- Cleanliness: treatment rooms, towels, and equipment should be visibly clean.
- Equipment: ask what type of beds they have (high-pressure vs low-pressure, stand-up options) and how often bulbs are replaced.
- Certifications: spray technicians should be trained; staff should offer skin evaluations and safe exposure guidance.
- Safety practices: goggles, timers, hygiene protocols, and COVID/vaccine policies if relevant to you.
- Pricing and membership: check single sessions, packages, membership contracts and cancellation policies.
- Results: ask for before/after photos or client references; look for consistent, natural results in reviews.
- Trial session: many salons offer a first-time discounted session — use it to evaluate staff and results.

Common reputable chains to check (verify current locations)
- Palm Beach Tan
- Sun Tan City
- Planet Beach (spa-focused; some locations offer spray)

If you tell me your zip code or paste two–three salon names you’ve found, I can help compare them (based on reviews, services, and the checklist above) and recommend the best fit.
